text:
deploy-bot: Starting rollout: release=2026.03.12 -> eu-west canary (10%)
anna (oncall): saw a sharp spike in 502/504s for eu-west around the start of the canary. grafana: https://grafana.redwood/graph?panelId=502s-eu-west :fire:
incident-bot: Paging oncall: SEV1 alert - high 5xx rate - project=inference-api - region=eu-west - threshold=5%% over baseline
anna (oncall): I'm oncall and looking now
ben (platform): I can see 502s in the green pods' upstream logs: "upstream reset by peer" and a bunch of 503s from edge LB. pulling recent route config
caroline (sre): running quick DNS check to rule out traffic split oddness
caroline (sre): ```
$ dig +short eu.api.redwood-inference.com @8.8.8.8
34.82.1.12
34.82.201.33
;; TTL 300
```
caroline (sre): Those IPs map to old-blue-elb and new-green-elb respectively. TTL=300. Not ideal during rollout but expected.
dmitri (support): multiple enterprise customers are reporting errors (ticket #INC-4312). sample: "embedding call returning 504" from eu-west users.
anna (oncall): trying curl against both IPs to repro
anna (oncall): ```
# to old-blue
$ curl -s -w "%%{http_code}" -o /dev/null http://34.82.1.12/v1/generate
502
# to new-green
$ curl -s -w "%%{http_code}" -o /dev/null http://34.82.201.33/v1/generate
200
```
ben (platform): that suggests some requests are still being routed to the old blue where the new endpoint/path isn't ready -> 502. checking routing service weights and geo configuration now
ben (platform): looking at router state: eu-west weights appear inverted. Expected canary mapping: green=10%%, blue=90%% (or vice versa depending on rollout), but live shows green=20%%, blue=80%% for this rollout which doesn't match our deploy job output.
anna (oncall): how did that mismatch happen? deploy job should have set weights based on release metadata
ben (platform): digging into deploy logs, the rollout job reads region mapping from env var REGION_MAP. PR #2345 accidentally included a typo: key used "eu_west" (underscore) while router expects "eu-west" (dash). So weight update applied to a non-existent region entry and fallback left a stale manual weight on blue.
caroline (sre): ok mitigation plan: 1) immediate kill-switch for feature flag "new-inference-path" (stop traffic to the new code path) 2) set router weight to route 100%% -> green or rollback canary fully. Which is faster?
anna (oncall): kill-switch first (lower blast radius) then fix router weights. I'll coordinate with support comms.
caroline (sre): flipping flag now via internal-toggle (30s)
caroline (sre): ```
# internal toggle CLI
$ rd-flag set new-inference-path false --env=eu-west --actor=caroline
Flag update queued -> success
```
caroline (sre): :white_check_mark: flag off. Monitoring.
ben (platform): pushing router weight override to force green 100%% for eu-west (routing-mgr API)
ben (platform): ```
$ curl -X POST https://router-api.redwood/v1/weights -H "Authorization: Bearer $ROUTER_TOKEN" -d '{"region":"eu-west","weights":{"green":100,"blue":0}}'
{"status":"ok","applied":true}
```
ben (platform): applied weight override, edge confirms config sync to all proxies in ~20s
anna (oncall): graphs showing 5xx drop back to baseline within ~3m of the weight change. nice.
incident-bot: Alert status: SEV1 -> SEV2 (error rates decreasing)
dmitri (support): I'll send a short status update to affected customers and add note about mitigation and ETA for full rollback. drafting now.
anna (oncall): to be safe i'm rolling the canary back to previous image after flag+weight ops succeed
anna (oncall): ```
# k8s rollback
$ kubectl -n inference rollout undo deployment/inference-api --to-revision=135
deployment.apps/inference-api "inference-api" rolled back
```
anna (oncall): rollback complete, verifying pods come up healthy
ben (platform): healthchecks passing, error rate stable at baseline. cherry on top: verifying no new 5xx spike in last 10m.
caroline (sre): quick root-cause notes: deploy job didn't fail loudly on missing region mapping key -> silent no-op. deploy config parsing should validate region keys and fail if mismatch.
dmitri (support): current customer impact summary for ops notes: ~4%% of eu-west requests hit legacy blue path and returned 5xx during ~12 minutes of the rollout window. 6 enterprise customers opened tickets, no data exfiltration, real-time features degraded.
anna (oncall): handing off to ben (platform) for postmortem write-up and permanent fix. I'll be off-call in 10m.
ben (platform): taking handoff. immediate ACTIONS: (1) revert deploy script PR to patch region key handling (2) add unit test for REGION_MAP key normalization (3) add router API sync check as preflight in rollout job (4) reduce DNS TTL during future rollouts to 60s by default (5) add monitor for mixed-A-records that map to caches with different feature sets.
caroline (sre): also add an alert when ratio of 5xx between A-record IPs in same region > 2x.
incident-bot: Incident state: mitigated -> monitoring. oncall owner=ben (platform).
ben (platform): I'll draft the postmortem and the notes for the rollout runbook. ETA EOD.
anna (oncall): thanks team. closing the on-call page. please add any additional notes here and I'll append to the incident timeline. :thumbsup:
